newsitem.title: USA: U.S. industrial output dropped in October.
newsitem.headline: U.S. industrial output dropped in October.

text.p: Strikes that shut auto plants in Canada and the United States caused the first decline in U.S. industrial output in seven months during October, the Federal Reserve said on Friday.

Total output by the nation's factories, mines and utilities fell 0.5 percent last month after rising a revised 0.3 percent in September. It was the first monthly falloff since a 0.5 percent drop last March.
"Sharp drops in the production of motor vehicles and in the output of related parts and materials accounted for the decrease in the overall index," the U.S. central bank said.
